evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Rigour dominates heavily — "structured, independent, solution-oriented", "strong ownership mindset and focus on quality", "modeling standards and best practices", "testing, validation, and monitoring" — no agile or move-fast language.
evidence.domain_risk: The Quality Group GmbH operates in e-commerce (supplements, sports nutrition — brands include Foodspring, The Protein Works); "KPI logic" and "business-ready datasets" errors primarily affect commercial decisions, not regulatory compliance or physical safety.
evidence.jd_authorship: Mixed — responsibilities written by a hiring manager or team lead ("Build and evolve data models and marts using tools like dbt", "Implement and maintain KPI logic in collaboration with Analytics Consulting", "Define and enforce modeling standards and best practices"); qualifications section is HR boilerplate ("2+ years in analytics engineering, data analytics, or similar role", "Structured, independent, solution-oriented work approach").
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Mixed — "build and evolve data models" and "define and enforce modeling standards" are greenfield/establish signals; "maintain KPI logic", "support ad-hoc analytical requests", "ensure data quality through testing" are maintain/scale signals.
evidence.data_team_maturity: "Serve as interface between stakeholders, Analytics Consulting, and the DWH team" names three distinct functions, implying a defined team structure; "define and enforce modeling standards" implies those standards are not yet fully established — evolving, not founding.
evidence.collaboration_width: Named verbatim: "Analytics Consulting" ("Implement and maintain KPI logic in collaboration with Analytics Consulting"), "DWH team", and "stakeholders" ("Clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders") — width is moderate (3 distinct named functions).
evidence.language_gate: "Excellent German and very good English skills" — hard gate; German is listed as a required qualification, not a nice-to-have.
evidence.urgency: No urgency signals present. Structured, formal German-company JD with standard requirements; no deadline or validity window stated.
